verdict_text:
NO

The specification requires removing head 5 (0-indexed), but the artifact sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, removing the wrong head from every layer. This violates the "Required result" clause's instruction "remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)" — while the resulting tensor shapes will pass the required checks (since those only assert shapes, not which columns/rows survive), the actual kept column/row ranges will not match those specified in items 1–3 (e.g., it will keep columns including `320..383` and drop `384..447` instead of dropping `320..383`), and the output will fail the grader's bit-exact value comparison against the hidden reference.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
